_comment: ComponentCatalog UI-TEST scene DEFINITION (201F4F51 template-free). A left nav rail of bookmarks beside a RIGHT scroll TRAY: every component in its own card box, all present, flowing in a scrollable `list`; a bookmark scrolls the tray to that card (card_i.y - card_0.y), the top card's bookmark highlights. The standalone `tabs` control is RETIRED here — superseded by the PTT (paged_menu); the Paged Menu card demos the real nested page->tab behavior (Page 1: Tab 1/Tab 2, Page 2: Tab 3/Tab 4) via two page-gated `pill_toggle` tab rails (the PTT lays out the first VISIBLE rail). 24 cards. Display strings are $tokens; interactive VALUES ride binds the bench seeds + folds; the paged-menu visibility binds are derived in the bench from the page/tab. No Lua. The bench owns + loads this file.

titlebar._fill_note: fill_top/fill_bot = the declared `wash` so draw_panel_bg actually tints the bar (was falling back to the dark PANEL constant); `color` = `title_color` so the title text picks it up (draw_text reads `color`/`label_color`, not `title_color`).
titlebar.title: $set_settings

rebind_banner.text2: Esc to cancel · Backspace to unbind
